title: Doc manifest
description: Index of every documentation file's front-matter, keyed by its path relative to docs/. Used by documentation-reviewer for drift checks.

module.description: Module name (e.g. 'time-entry', 'goals', 'planning', 'shared', 'core') or 'root' for cross-cutting docs.

generated_by.description: 'human' for hand-written curated docs, or the agent name that generated/last regenerated this file.

source_commit.description: Commit SHA this generated doc was produced against. Only present on docs/generated/** files.

sources.description: Files this doc was derived from, for drift detection.
